'''Healers''' were [[Sedrian]]s capable of treating wounded individuals. They employed a [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]] extract to treat their patients. One such healer plied her trade in the marketplace in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
